summary: Four red services/deployment tests fixed (dispatcher, mfc_r4 contract x2, paper_scope) by supplying the identities and owner-read seams production requires; no auth check relaxed, no assertion weakened, no skip/deselect. The six test_promote_pipeline.py failures are out of scope: promote_pipeline.py and its test are restored to dev and are retired by PROMOTE-PIPELINE-RETIRE-20261019 (operator decision 2026-10-19).
